title: Cyclic single-molecule magnets: from the odd-numbered heptanuclear to a dimer of heptanuclear dysprosium clusters

synthesis.procedure: To a slurry of H2EDDC (59.6 mg, 0.20 mmol) and triethylamine (0.14 mL, 1.0 mmol) in methanol (20 mL) was added solid Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (164.8 mg, 0.40 mmol). After stirring for 24 h, H2opch (108.0 mg, 0.40 mmol) and 1-naphthylphosphonic acid C10H7PO3H2 (20.8 mg, 0.10 mmol) were added to the pale yellow solution. The mixture was stirred for another 24 h and filtered. The yellow filtrate was sealed in a 25 mL glass vessel and heated in a drying oven at 100 °C. Red single crystals formed after 48 h as a single-phase product. Elemental analysis matches C110H108Dy7N24O39P3; TGA shows loss of six methanol molecules (5.2% observed, 5.3% calculated) between 30 and 250 °C.
synthesis.time: 24 h, then 24 h stirring, then 48 h heating
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 25 mL sealed glassware in a drying oven (solvothermal)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; red single crystals formed directly as a single-phase product.

properties.summary: Compound 1 is a zero-field SMM. χMT falls from 102.89 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K to 86.46 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K (1 kOe), consistent with crystal-field depopulation and possible intramolecular antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization reaches 40.61 μB at 1.8 K and 7 T, below the 70 μB saturation value, and M vs H/T curves do not superimpose. A one-step hysteresis loop has an effective coercive field of 0.15 kOe at 1.8 K. AC data under zero dc field show two well-separated relaxation processes (fast, FR; slow, SR) with Orbach barriers of 74 K (τ0 = 1.49×10−6 s) and 177 K (τ0 = 3.84×10−11 s); below 8 K the quantum regimes have characteristic times 0.00042 s (FR) and 0.22 s (SR). Applied dc fields do not suppress the dynamics above 2.0 K.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared as for compound 1 except that the amount of 1-naphthylphosphonic acid was doubled. To a slurry of H2EDDC (59.6 mg, 0.20 mmol) and triethylamine (0.14 mL, 1.0 mmol) in methanol (20 mL) was added Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (164.8 mg, 0.40 mmol). After stirring for 24 h, H2opch (108.0 mg, 0.40 mmol) and C10H7PO3H2 (41.6 mg, 0.20 mmol) were added. The mixture was stirred for another 24 h, filtered, sealed in a 25 mL glass vessel and heated at 100 °C for 48 h, giving red single crystals. Elemental analysis is fitted to C212H168Dy14N48O66P10·9H2O; TGA (30–260 °C) shows a 3.3% loss corresponding to thirteen water molecules. The CCDC model contains four lattice water molecules.
synthesis.time: 24 h, then 24 h stirring, then 48 h heating

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; red single crystals formed directly as a single-phase product.

properties.summary: Compound 2 is also a zero-field SMM, but with much smaller barriers than 1. χMT rises from 204.29 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K to a maximum of 226.14 cm3 K mol−1 at 90 K, indicating dominant intramolecular ferromagnetic coupling, then falls to 141.47 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K (1 kOe). Magnetization reaches 89.12 μB at 1.8 K and 7 T, below 140 μB, and a spindle-shaped hysteresis loop at 1.8 K indicates fast zero-field relaxation. Two thermally activated regimes give barriers of 6.4 K (τ0 = 1.18×10−5 s, 1.8–3.0 K) and 20.7 K (τ0 = 9.09×10−6 s, 5.0–8.0 K). Cole–Cole plots (1.8–4.0 K) are asymmetric with α ≈ 0.18 and are not well described by a single generalized Debye model.
